respect_dignity.name: Equal dignity
respect_dignity.message: If you respect only women whose choices you approve of, what you respect is your own approval.

respect_consent.name: A freely given yes
respect_consent.message: If she cannot say no without fearing your reaction, what is the yes you hope for worth?

respect_boundaries.name: Respecting a no
respect_boundaries.message: Your disappointment is yours to handle. She does not owe you a yes to ease it.

respect_empathy.name: In her shoes
respect_empathy.message: Imagine how you would feel in her place, then listen to her: your imagination cannot replace her experience.

respect_freedom.name: Love without control
respect_freedom.message: Fear of losing her gives you no claim over her freedom.

respect_anger.name: The strength to stay calm
respect_anger.message: Respect also shows in what you choose not to do when you are angry.

respect_sexism.name: Standing up to sexism
respect_sexism.message: Before you laugh along, ask who has to pretend it is funny.

respect_privacy.name: Respecting her privacy
respect_privacy.message: She trusted you with something personal. That trust never gave you the right to expose it.

respect_solidarity.name: Support without imposing
respect_solidarity.message: Helping her means making room for her to decide, not deciding for her.

respect_accountability.name: Owning your actions
respect_accountability.message: You will know you have changed when you respond differently to the same frustration.

respect_happiness.name: Her happiness
respect_happiness.message: Taking joy in seeing her thrive also means celebrating what she achieves without you.

respect_fantasy.name: Fantasy
respect_fantasy.message: Sex is not the most important thing in life. Tenderness, trust and closeness matter much more to the happiness you build together. Seek your own happiness and help her find hers and flourish.

respect_worth.name: Self-worth
respect_worth.message: Whether or not you have a sex life says nothing about your worth. You have nothing to prove.

respect_tenderness.name: Tenderness
respect_tenderness.message: Some moments of happiness take very little: someone who listens, a shared laugh, or company that makes you feel good.

respect_desire.name: Desire
respect_desire.message: You can desire someone without making their response the measure of your happiness.

respect_love.name: Love
respect_love.message: The quality of a relationship also shows in how free both people are to be themselves, speak and say no.

respect_full_life.name: A full life
respect_full_life.message: Friendship, creating things, helping one another and the joy of learning can give your life as much meaning as love or sex.

first_steps.name: LIFT YOUR HEAD
first_steps.message: You are a wonderful creature! The first step is always the most important.

move_now.name: MOVE NOW!
move_now.message: Action creates momentum. Keep moving forward, don't stop!

break_silence.name: BREAK THE SILENCE
break_silence.message: Your voice matters. Express yourself, make yourself heard. The world awaits you!

persevere.name: PERSEVERE
persevere.message: Perseverance beats talent. Keep going, you're on the right path!

release.name: RELEASE
release.message: Free yourself from your chains. Let go of what holds you back.

stand_up.name: STAND UP!
stand_up.message: Get up! You are a warrior, a champion. Don't stay down!

jesus_loves.name: YOU ARE LOVED
jesus_loves.message: Jesus loves you as you are. His love is unconditional and eternal.

halfway.name: HALFWAY THERE
halfway.message: You've come halfway! Keep going, the best is yet to come!

combo_master.name: COMBO MASTER
combo_master.message: Extraordinary combo! You've mastered the art of connection!

warrior.name: WARRIOR OF LIGHT
warrior.message: You are a warrior! Your courage inspires the world around you.

unstoppable.name: UNSTOPPABLE
unstoppable.message: Nothing can stop you! You are a force of nature!

master.name: ABSOLUTE MASTER
master.message: You've reached supreme mastery! You are extraordinary!

ultimate_trophy.name: ULTIMATE TROPHY
ultimate_trophy.message: MAXIMUM level reached! You are an absolute champion! Discover Emmanuel's inclusive universe.
